name: Icosaxes Hexa
status: new (eight Icosaxes round an Unborn Axes as one solid, the node of the Icosaxes Kagome network; not found in the sources searched, #59)
scale_note: #59 frame = #48 frame (regular icosahedron of edge 1, lattice spacing phi): Icosaxes at the points (phi/2)(2Z)^3, Unborn Axes at (phi/2)(2Z+1)^3. Icosaxes Hexa: the eight Icosaxes on the corners (phi/2)(+-1, +-1, +-1) of a cube round the Unborn Axes at its centre, the origin, joined into one solid (the same solid as nine Icosaxes passing through each other, #59 section 5).

source.path: research branch (commit 41e1213c): studies/2026-10-27-icosaxes-twenty (H2); k-mix src/app/bloom-geometry.js hexa(false); exact from the #48 objects

composition.note: Version 3 composition: the solid is the union of the convex `pieces` (dataset solids placed by x -> R x + t; interior-disjoint, meeting face to face), minus the tetrahedra in `minus` (dents), plus those in `plus` (keys). "tricap": the #48 Tricap of the Unborn centred at unborn_centre (as in dicto-lotus-jewel-axes); "mirrored tricap": that Tricap mirrored in its base plane (krp-core golden-split.js INTO_SMALL: the key of a big piece). Re-proved by check.py.

credit_note: Credit: DICTO (idea, names); exact computation with Claude (Anthropic).

centre.kind: origin of the frame (= the corner centroid)

unit_volume.note: x -> centre + s (x - centre), s = V^(-1/3) with V the exact volume above; s is symbolic and the corners are decimals (15 places, as elsewhere). Same corner order and faces as above; volume 1.

checks.verified_by: check.py (python3 + sympy), re-run from this file alone
